sections.title: Warmer, colder
sections.content: To compare two things, add -bb to the adjective (after a consonant a linking vowel comes first and follows vowel harmony: meleg → melegebb, magas → magasabb; after a vowel it is just -bb: olcsó → olcsóbb, and a final -a/-e lengthens: drága → drágább): meleg → *melegebb* ("warmer"), hideg → *hidegebb* ("colder"). Use *mint* ("than") to name what you're comparing to: *Nyáron* *melegebb* van, *mint* *télen*. ("In summer it's warmer than in winter.")

items.english: In summer it's warmer than in winter.

items.spanish: Az ősz hidegebb, mint a nyár.

sections.content: Word order matters: put mint right before what you're comparing to — melegebb, mint *télen*, not mint *télen* melegebb.
